description: Test suite for payload helper functions related to interactive message handling, including functions that check for reply content, normalize responses, and resolve text fallbacks.

methods.name: hasReplyChannelData
methods.description: Checks if the provided object contains non-empty reply channel data, specifically if it has Slack blocks.

methods.name: hasReplyContent
methods.description: Determines if the reply object contains meaningful content, ignoring whitespace-only text.

methods.name: hasReplyPayloadContent
methods.description: Checks if the reply payload contains significant content, considering text and channel data.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveReply
methods.description: Normalizes interactive reply blocks into a consistent format.

methods.name: resolveInteractiveTextFallback
methods.description: Resolves and concatenates text fallback content from an interactive reply.
